entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: Archangel in charge of Serra's armies who took command of Serra's Realm under Phyrexia's influence and died fighting Urza.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker who created and then left Serra's Realm.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: The plane Radiant ruled until its collapse.

entities.name: Collapse of Serra's Realm
entities.description: Collapse caused by Radiant's holy war.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Came to save the realm and staged an exodus.

events.summary: Radiant occupied Serra's Palace after Serra left, tainted by a Phyrexian agent into waging holy war on Serrans.
events.quote: she was convinced Serrans were becoming Phyrexians and waged a holy war against the plane's terrified inhabitants

events.summary: Urza came to save the realm and had to stage an exodus; Radiant tried to prevent it and nearly killed him by tearing out the Mightstone and Weakstone.
events.quote: nearly managed to kill him by tearing out the Mightstone and Weakstone from his skull

events.summary: Radiant died trying to reunite the two stones, destroying the palace, saying 'I am the mad one!'

relations.note: Archangel in charge of her armies.
relations.quote: Radiant was the archangel in charge of the planeswalker Serra 's armies on Serra's Realm .
